messages:
oliver: heads up — seeing repeated allreduce stalls on ~1000s jobs hitting ap-sg-1 GPU pool since last night :face_with_thermometer:
oliver: symptoms = 4+ minute NCCL hangs then job falls back to TCP and runs 3-4x slower
maria: ugh. any recent infra changes in APAC?
oliver: we rolled MLX5 fw to v2.41.18 on the pool ~03:00 UTC yesterday, coincides with first reports
ken: possible. did we change any switch config or PFC?
oliver: not that I'm aware of. networking team shows PFC enabled but a couple ToR ports got a config push around the same time.
sophie: can you paste the mlx counters and `ibdev` output?
oliver: posted quick capture from node gpu-az5-12:```
# ibstats mlx5_0 1
port: 1
 Tx state: Active Rx state: Active
 port_rcv_errors: 0
 port_xmit_discards: 12
 tx_retries_exceeded: 18
 rnr_nak: 34
 qp_drops: 7
```
maria: tx_retries + rnr_nak spikes look like transient packet loss or ordering issues at L2/L3
ken: could be QP recovery thrashing after firmware tweak. also see `qp_drops` — that usually means the QP went to ERR.
oliver: logs from one of the hung jobs show:```
NCCL INFO: Allreduce op stalled, last progress at 2024-06-14T03:12:01Z
NCCL WARN: Detected unexpected QP state transition ERR -> RESET
```
infra-bot: detected: 8 nodes in ap-sg-1 with elevated `tx_retries_exceeded` over last 6h (alert id: rdma-20240614-08)
maria: can infra team quickly confirm if routes from those nodes cross a specific ToR pair? want to rule out asymmetric routing or partial MTU blackhole.
ken: @networking we need a route map for src=10.40.*/24 -> dst=10.40.*/24 for the affected nodes, and check if any VXLAN offload or ACL was applied last night.
sophie: quick check — `ethtool -k` on one node shows `tx-checksum-ip-generic: on` and `tx-checksum-sctp: off` but `gro` offloading differs across nodes. that can cause reordering when combined with offload bugs.
maria: also ask TOR team to inspect MLX switch config — I want to confirm PFC is consistently set and no ECN policies are suddenly dropping RoCE traffic.
oliver: replication plan: gonna revert fw on two canary nodes to v2.40.x and run the failing training job to see if it recovers. will also capture `ibv_devinfo` and `ibstat` during run.
ken: +1 on canary revert. collect `rdma_core` logs and kernel dmesg too. if QP transitions to ERR we should have kernel traces.
sophie: if revert fixes it, we should schedule a rollback for the pool and open a FW bug with Mellanox. include counter dumps before/after.
maria: timeline — can we confirm canary results in 2 hours? we need to coordinate with scheduler to evict test job on those nodes.
oliver: evicting now, will repro and report back. thanks all :thumbsup:
(reacts: infra-bot :eyes:)
